name: Tube travel
description: Shots line the inside of a long 3D tube; scrolling travels along it and a click flies one shot out beside its details.

default.title: Launch Week
default.line: A title comp, Bounce In Characters.
default.desc: A Launch Week title comp: text over a photo, with the Bounce In Characters animation preset in the Effects and Presets panel. Text animators come with 169 presets.
default.alt: A Launch Week title comp in FormVFX: white text over a sunset photograph, with the Effects and Presets panel and the timeline

default.title: The viewer
default.line: The comp, as it will render.
default.desc: The Composition viewer shows the comp with zoom, quality and view controls beneath it, and the on-screen handles of the selected layer drawn over the picture.
default.alt: The FormVFX Composition viewer showing a Launch Week title over a photograph, with the viewer controls below it

default.title: Intro comp
default.desc: Compositions hold layers, precomps, shapes and text, animated with keyframes. This intro has a ring and an orb over a backdrop, laid out in the layer stack under the viewer.
default.alt: The FormVFX window with an intro composition of an orange orb and a ring, the layer stack and graph beneath it

default.title: The orb
default.desc: Shape layers, text, masks and track mattes composite on the GPU through wgpu, or on the CPU when that is faster for the comp, in a compositor written in Rust.
default.alt: A close view of the FormVFX viewer with an orange orb inside a ring and the formvfx wordmark below it

default.title: Flowchart
default.line: The comp, seen as a graph.
default.desc: The Flowchart wires solids, effects and layers into a composition. Drag a link to parent a layer or set a track matte, and drag effects to reorder a stack.
default.alt: The FormVFX Flowchart tab under the viewer, with solids, effects and layers wired into an intro composition

default.title: Nodes
default.line: Drag a link, set a matte.
default.desc: It is the same project, seen as a graph, so a change in the Flowchart is a change in the timeline. Links parent layers and set track mattes, and effects reorder by dragging.
default.alt: Solid, effect and layer nodes in the FormVFX Flowchart connected by links into the formvfx intro comp

default.title: A node view
default.desc: Solids, effects and layers are wired into a composition, with Glow and Gradient Ramp effects feeding the layers that make up the intro, all in one view.
default.alt: The FormVFX window with the Flowchart open, showing Backdrop, Glow, Gradient Ramp and layers wired into a composition

default.title: Graph Editor
default.desc: Shape every ease on a curve, with Hold, Linear, Ease In and Ease Out one click away. The work area renders into the preview cache while you work.
default.alt: The FormVFX Graph Editor beside the layer stack, showing an ease curve between two keyframes

default.title: Ease curves
default.desc: Keyframes carry eases and roving keys, and the Graph Editor, Wiggler, Smoother and Motion Sketch refine them. Expressions run on FormVFX's own interpreter.
default.alt: A close view of the FormVFX Graph Editor with an ease curve and the Hold, Linear and Ease buttons above it

default.title: Effects list
default.desc: 306 effects, from keying and Color Grade to OCIO transforms, blurs, distortions and particles, listed by category in the Effects and Presets panel beside the viewer.
default.alt: The FormVFX Effects and Presets panel listing categories such as Animation Presets, 3D Channel, Audio, Blur and Sharpen, and Keying

default.title: Timeline
default.desc: A headline layer and a photo layer sit on the timeline under the viewer, with the playhead on the title. Render settings and the Render Queue sit in the next tab.
default.alt: The FormVFX timeline with a Headline layer and a photo layer, a playhead, and the viewer above them

default.title: Layer stack
default.desc: The layer stack lists each layer with its switches, mode and parent, with keyframes on the time ruler beside it and an ease curve for the selected property.
default.alt: The FormVFX layer stack with Orb, Ring, formvfx and Backdrop layers and their parent and link settings, beside the time ruler

default.title: Wiring
default.desc: Drag an effect to reorder a stack, or drag a link to set a track matte. The graph and the timeline are two views of one project, so neither goes out of date.
default.alt: Nodes in the FormVFX Flowchart: motion graphics layers and a composition node joined by links

default.title: Presets
default.desc: Text animators come with 169 presets, such as Bounce In Characters and Bounce In Lines, found in the Effects and Presets panel with a search box above it.
default.alt: The FormVFX Effects and Presets panel searched for bounce, listing Text Animate In, Bounce In Characters, Bounce In Lines and Scale Bounce Loop

propDocs.captures: Map of picture key to {u:{1024,2400}, w, h}: two widths of the same picture and its pixel size.
propDocs.shots: Array of {title, meta:[3 words], line, desc, alt, stats:[[value,label],[value,label]], dl:[[key,value],[key,value]], face:{c, l, x, y, w}}. face.c and face.l are keys of captures (dark and light picture, l may be null); x and y are the crop centre as fractions and w is the crop width as a fraction.
propDocs.openVariable: Boolean variable the component sets while a shot is flown out, so native chrome can fade away.
propDocs.indexVariable: Boolean variable that opens and closes the index list; a native button can toggle it.
propDocs.shareVariable: Boolean variable the component clears on Escape, outside clicks and when a shot opens; a native popover binds to it.

fallback: The poster shows the tube at rest. Without 3D transforms the shots are listed as buttons, and with reduced motion the tube settles at once with a short fade.
